notes.title: Islands of Ice and Fire expansion released! (Version 1.8)
notes.notes:
You can now buy Islands of Ice and Fire!

A large expansion for the game, it brings completely new areas, quests, monsters and a new weapon class: crossbows!

It's recommended for those who finished the main quest, but you can access it whenever you like. Talk to Captain Hanty in Mithria harbor.

Enjoy!


Also, if you have played the expansion already on other platforms: we have added new quests and improved the others! :)
